note: SNG-287 — GENERATIVE TITLES. A name that comes from the material, not from a menu (Aevi, the Tether pattern).
howToRead: A title is `pattern + slots`, and EVERY slot is filled from a real record or the pattern is not used. No arc moved means no {ARC} title. That rule is what makes a title true rather than flattering — the same discipline as BOUNDARY-1, where prose alone is not a consequence. ⚠️ THREE SLOTS FROM THE SPEC HAVE NO SOURCE YET and any pattern using them is skipped: {ROAD} (nothing records which road a figure guarded), {CRAFT} (deeds carry tags, not craft ids) and {FOE} (casualties are per pass, with no per-figure record of who someone beat). They are listed in `engine/titles.js:UNFILLABLE_SLOTS` rather than left to look available. ⛔ DIRECTIVE SNG-280: where a pattern has two faces, the one that lands is decided by the SIGN OF THE RECORDED DEEDS — a description of what someone is known for, never a verdict on it. The Maw earns a name as readily as the Rootkin; it is simply a different noun.

patterns.note: The largest single thing a figure can be there for. Requires a recorded stage-move, which is why it is rare.

⛔ THE SAME PATTERN, TWO FACES. Thornwake's Mercy and Thornwake's Knife are the same construction; which noun lands is read off the sign of the deeds. A mixed record resolves to NEITHER and the pattern is skipped — a person who is not known for one thing does not get told they are.
⚠️ THE BEST ONE (Aevi): the domain-scope pattern. It says nothing about what you did and everything about WHO IS TALKING.
Only reachable by a figure who has actually been retrieved from the death state more than once. Ties the death ladder to the name.

SNG-294 (Aevi): renamed from 'Warden of {ROAD}'. THE WORLD HAS LOCATIONS, NOT NAMED ROUTES — 'the Medicine Road' was fiction the data cannot support. Ships against the place a figure's deeds concentrate in; {ROAD} waits for routes to become things, which the economy and travel-cost effects both want.

SNG-294 (Aevi): re-sourced from {CRAFT}. A tag is what the WORLD noticed; a craft id is what the ENGINE resolved. Threading craft ids into reputation would make a deed an engine artifact instead of a social record. Same title, honest source, no plumbing.
SNG-294 (Aevi): built — the clash already held winner, loser and both weights, so the best foe is one line. Names the hardest thing they ever put down, by rung rather than recency.

_tagEpithets: SNG-294: the world's word for a habit. A tag becomes an epithet only if the world HAS a word for it — an unmapped tag yields no title rather than a coined one, which is the same honesty rule as the slots.
